data_fields.name: hp_clamp
data_fields.donor_constant: damage capped at remaining hit points; hit points floor at 0

data_fields.name: splat_lifetime
data_fields.donor_constant: one tick: reset in resetPathingEntity at end of tick

data_fields.name: hit_type
data_fields.donor_constant: type id checked by HitTypeValid on the NPC_DAMAGE op

best_idea: Keep a per-target hit record for one tick that clamps each hit to the hit points actually removed and is cleared at the end of the tick, but store every hit rather than two display slots.
decision_why: Every hit must reach the one ledger; the clamp and per-tick reset are reusable, but the two-slot store silently drops the first hit when a third lands in the same tick (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3).
acceptance: With three attackers landing hits in one server tick on one defender, the client shows three values (or one per attacker), each equal to the hit points removed; a server test asserts hit points fall by the sum of the clamped damage, the tick record holds three entries, and the record is empty on the next tick.
